items.title: Major tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to fears of AI slowdown
items.summary: The market has been reacting to possible tougher scrutiny of data centre construction and the AI industry following the US midterms

confirmed_facts.text: Major tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to fears of AI slowdown - Published Hundreds of billions of dollars in market value has been wiped from major tech firms in a stock market rout after the US midterm elections sparked concerns of a slowdown in AI development.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Major tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to fears of AI slowdown - Published Hundreds of billions of dollars in market value has been wiped from major tech firms in a stock market rout after the US midterm elections sparked concerns of a slowdown in AI development.

items.title: Americans voted against Trump's Iran war. Gulf countries hope that means an end to the conflict
items.summary: The US midterm results showed how unpopular Donald Trump's Iran war is. Now, Gulf countries, trapped for months in the middle of the war between the US and Iran, see reason for optimism.
